shadows.name: workspace
shadows.purpose: Structural frame with ambient HUD glow.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Transform, shadow, and color state transitions.

motion.name: chart-transition
motion.purpose: Unread chart uses scaleX, not width animation.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Lime action with a hard shadow, lift, and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:42px;padding:9px 15px;border:2px solid var(--edge);border-radius:2px;font-family:'Space Grotesk','Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.35;background:var(--action);color:var(--action-ink);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--shadow);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 180ms var(--ease),box-shadow 180ms var(--ease),background-color 180ms var(--ease)}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translate(-2px,-2px);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--shadow),0 5px 20px var(--glow)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent-color);outline-offset:4px}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translate(1px,1px);box-shadow:none}.ds-primary:disabled{color:var(--text-muted);background:var(--surface-muted);border-color:var(--border-color);box-shadow:none;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}:host-context([data-motion='reduced']) .ds-primary{transition:none}

components.name: Reading surface
components.description: Opaque email prose surface with a readable measure.
components.html: Message content stays readable within the operational workspace.

narrative.overview: Neo-brutalist frames, hard offset shadows, lime actions, and cyan instrumentation establish a tactile communication workspace. Stronger glow and animated provider routes express the user's chosen HUD direction; readable communication stays central in both light and dark themes. The implementation is code-first React/CSS/SVG.

rules.name: Readable communication
rules.body: Message surfaces remain opaque; use theme-specific readable semantic text with labels.

rules.name: Motion preference
rules.body: Persist the interface preference under omni_desk_motion. OS reduced-motion always suppresses motion; the visible control must describe effective motion.

rules.name: Loaded-view evidence
rules.body: Overview counts describe loaded conversations or chats; provider routes are illustrative and do not assert provider health.

dos: Do preserve real authentication and provider behavior.
Do retain mobile overview and filters disclosures.
Do ship the self-hosted Space Grotesk font with its OFL license.
Do use transform-based chart animation and honor OS reduced motion.
donts: Don't invent activity or operational measurements.
Don't apply glass transparency to message prose.
Don't imply message sending or AI generation beyond the implemented MVP.
